confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. July is rainy-season low season, so lodging may run below peak rates. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine_glass are inferred from the local beer relationship (about 3x and 4x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain. FX value taken from search-result text for the RBA exchange-rates page (4pm, 14 Oct 2026); the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Estimated from general knowledge of Phnom Penh tourist pricing, loosely benchmarked against other Southeast Asian tourist cities such as Siem Reap and Ho Chi Minh City; no single comparable city was used.
